changelog:
v1.0.3 Release Notes & Features:
• Bulk 1-to-1 Caption Assignment: Sequential line-by-line caption pasting across Meta Business Suite Reel boxes.
• 1-3s Humanized Delay: Random 1 to 3 seconds pause after each description paste.
• Clean Single-Line Commenting: Auto-sanitizes comments to post exactly 1 clean comment per profile.
• No-Page Account Protection: Auto-detects accounts without active Pages, logs report, waits 3-4s, and closes browser.
• Instant Session Cookie Sync: Injects saved cookies immediately on startup so Facebook opens 100% logged in.
